about: Known vulnerabilities in production dependencies accepted for now: each says why it can't hurt here, and until when (scripts/audit-deps.mjs fails again after that date). docs/AUDIT.md.

accepted.reason: Zod 3 checks every item of a huge list. Every request goes through parse() (apps/server/src/lib/validate.ts), which refuses oversized lists and deep nesting before Zod sees them (test/hardening.test.ts); the direct Zod calls check single values. Fixed by moving to Zod 4.6.6+, planned.
